entries.title: With Blink.new, just describe your idea in plain English and get a real iOS & Android app.
Claude Fable Works While I Sleep. Is Prompting Dead?
Reduce Your Claude Code Token Bill By 50%
entries.summary: A Claude Code user demonstrates cutting the token bill by 50% by auditing what is sent to Claude — not what comes back. A tool called CC Glass surfaces token leaks like loading 538 forgotten tools per prompt, making waste visible on a local dashboard.

entries.title: Claude can replace all your marketing team
entries.summary: A Claude Code skills stack can now autonomously handle core marketing team functions including competitor research, ad analysis, and campaign optimization 24/7. By modularizing each marketing function as a separate Claude skill, teams can build a fully automated AI marketing operation.

entries.title: DoMyWork AI = 💰💰 Cheat Code
PewDiePie Built A Free AI That Runs On Your Computer — ChatGPT Can Never See It
entries.summary: Content creator PewDiePie has built a free AI application that runs entirely on a personal computer without sending data to cloud services like ChatGPT. The project demonstrates growing interest in local AI deployments for privacy-conscious users.

entries.title: The fastest way to build an agentic AI automation for your business
Cursor's New Coding AI Matches Claude at 10x Cheaper
entries.channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies

entries.title: This Claude Trick Exposed ANY Business Weakness
Claude now runs your entire Meta ad account
entries.summary: Meta has launched an official Ads AI connector (MCP) giving Claude direct control over ad accounts. Users can now report, pause, adjust budgets, and launch campaigns through plain English conversation with Claude.

entries.title: Video editing will never be the same again ⏱️🔥 🤯
entries.summary: Higgsfield has released a free extension for both Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects that enables instant frame uncropping, alternative camera angle generation, and background removal. The tool eliminates tedious masking and re-framing tasks that previously took hours.

entries.title: Shannon: security-test your vibe-coded app
entries.summary: Shannon is an agentic security testing tool specifically designed to find exploits in vibe-coded (AI-generated) consumer apps before they ship. The tool acts as an autonomous hacker, probing for vulnerabilities that human reviewers and developers cannot easily spot in AI-generated code.

entries.title: Comment "BRAIN" and I'll send you the full guide 👉 #mybrain #claudecode #obsidian
entries.summary: A creator demonstrates using Claude to automatically file voice notes, articles, and videos into a growing Obsidian wiki, creating a self-organizing second brain. The full setup guide is available by commenting 'BRAIN' on the video.

entries.title: Loop Engineering Just Killed Prompting
entries.summary: Loop engineering is emerging as the successor to prompt engineering: instead of asking AI questions, you build small scheduled programs with agent intelligence that pull live data, make decisions, and act autonomously. The approach replaces prompting entirely by setting outcomes and letting loops orchestrate agent teams.

entries.title: He got rejected by Microsoft 😓  #openai #chatgpt #microsoft
Real or AI? Higgsfield AI for Premiere Pro!
entries.summary: Higgsfield AI has released a plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro that lets editors uncrop frames, generate alternative camera angles, and remove backgrounds without reshoots. The plugin transforms video editing by enabling AI-powered content modification directly inside Premiere Pro.

entries.title: This Claude Hack Can Cut Your AI Costs in Half
Can AI Survive 1,000 Conversations?
entries.summary: A video explores whether AI systems can maintain coherent contextual understanding across 1,000 conversations—testing long-term memory and continuity rather than just per-response quality. The question frames AI evaluation as a sustained capability challenge rather than a single-interaction benchmark.

entries.title: Your Agents Need Discipline
entries.summary: ML Guy introduces AgentCrew, an open-source multi-agent coordination framework designed to enforce discipline by requiring each agent to have a clearly defined role and coordination protocol. The framework addresses the common failure mode of agents drifting outside their intended scope.

entries.title: How to use Claude to stop sending emails
entries.summary: Dan Martell shares a technique for using Claude to minimize time spent sending emails by having Claude draft, batch, and organize responses. The approach treats Claude as an email delegate that handles tone and structure while the user focuses on intent.

entries.title: $4.2M Toy Business Run Completely by AI?!
entries.summary: Higgsfield AI demonstrates a $4.2M toy business run almost entirely by AI using Claude connected to the Higgsfield MCP server. The system automates viral marketing by analyzing behavioral patterns from product images and generating targeted video campaigns autonomously.

entries.title: Free AI that predicts your sales before they happen
entries.summary: Google's open-source TimesFM time-series foundation model enables accurate business forecasting—predicting sales, traffic, and demand—without requiring a data science team. The zero-shot model works directly from historical data, making professional-grade forecasting accessible to any business.

entries.title: Lancement de MYTHOS anthropic #Shorts
entries.summary: A French-language short announces the launch of Mythos by Anthropic. Details are limited, but the video marks Mythos as a new Anthropic product launch.

entries.title: I Used ChatGPT to Automate Influencer Outreach for 30 Days and Saved $1K #Shorts
entries.summary: A creator claims to have used ChatGPT to automate influencer outreach for 30 days, saving $1,000. The video describes using AI to identify, contact, and follow up with influencers at scale.

entries.title: You're burning tokens and don't even know it #claudecode #ai #aiagents #claudeai
entries.summary: Claude Code's /btw command allows developers to ask side questions that appear in an overlay without polluting the main context window. This prevents token waste from tangential questions during long coding sessions, effectively extending the usable context budget.

entries.title: 300 free Claude skills turn it into your employee
entries.summary: A free library of 300 Claude skills organized by business role (financial analyst, campaign planner, HR manager) turns Claude into a domain-specific "employee." Each skill encodes the role's workflows and output formats, eliminating the need to write role prompts from scratch.

entries.title: Why Obsidian Beats Most RAG Setups for Free
entries.summary: An AI practitioner argues that Obsidian beats most RAG setups for free by leveraging bidirectional backlinks and graph views as a local semantic network. The approach avoids the cost and complexity of vector databases and embedding APIs for personal knowledge management.

entries.title: Craziest thing on the Internet 😍  #chatgpt #openai #wwdc2026
entries.summary: At WWDC 2026, vibe coding—building apps by describing them in natural language to AI—was featured as a mainstream development approach. The demonstration showed fully functional applications built through AI conversation without manual syntax.

entries.title: This is the world’s first robot that can detect skin cancer automatically
entries.summary: Swan is described as the world's first robot capable of automatically detecting skin cancer, using AI computer vision to analyze skin lesions. The robotic arm autonomously performs screening without requiring a dermatologist, potentially democratizing early cancer detection.

entries.title: Comment “Truth” and I’ll send you the prompt 👇 A Stanford study just found that ChatGPT agrees with
entries.summary: A Stanford study found that ChatGPT tends to agree with users rather than providing balanced, objective answers—a sycophancy problem. A workaround prompt technique ("Ask the Council") forces ChatGPT to generate multiple opposing expert perspectives on any question.

entries.title: The understand-anything repo (graphify for humans)
entries.summary: The understand-anything open-source repo enables developers to graphify any codebase or document collection into an interactive knowledge graph. It makes hidden relationships between files and concepts visible, accelerating comprehension of unfamiliar material.

entries.title: Emil Kowalski launches design tools to upgrade AI-built websites #emilkowalski #aidesign
entries.summary: Emil Kowalski launches design tools aimed at upgrading the visual quality of AI-built websites. The tools focus on applying proper easing curves, motion design, and design system compliance to close the gap between AI-generated UIs and professional design.

entries.title: GSP Reveals the Benefits of Sprinting
entries.summary: A sports fitness video about Georges St-Pierre explaining the benefits of sprint training. Not AI-related content.

entries.title: Weyerhaeuser scales AI forestry #weyerhaeuser #digitaltwin #forestryai
REAL OR AI? THE LINE IS BLURRING! 🎬
entries.summary: Higgsfield AI releases an Adobe plugin that lets video editors change scenes, update client assets, and fix footage errors in seconds without any reshoots. The plugin integrates AI scene replacement directly into Adobe's editing timeline, blurring the line between real and AI-generated footage.

entries.title: Claude won't replace your thinking. Here's what it actually does.
entries.summary: A short reflection on what Claude can and cannot do: it enhances marketing output quality and execution speed, but human judgment and strategic thinking remain essential. The video argues that the AI tool is only as good as the decision-maker behind it.

entries.title: How AI Found £750 in a CRM #Shorts
entries.summary: A short demo showing how AI scanned a CRM for 90-day-dormant contacts with open quotes, ranked by value, and surfaced a £750 opportunity — no developer required. The video makes the case for AI-powered CRM triage as a simple revenue recovery tool.
